mediaEvidence.title: Wilderness Survival Sandbox Game - Vintage Story
mediaEvidence.description: Vintage Story is an uncompromising wilderness survival sandbox game inspired by eldritch horror themes. Find yourself in a ruined world reclaimed by nature and permeated by unnerving temporal disturbances. Relive the advent of human civilization, or take your own path. Early Access. Fully playable on Windows, Mac and Linux. Buy now for 20 € / 24 $ Also available for purchase on* Held to high standards Honest pricing No marketplace. No paid loot boxes. No microtransactions. No Season pass. No paid DLC. No hidden fees. No pay2win. No ads. No user data monetization. Social We provide safe and ad-free community platforms for our players. Come visit us on the official forum , Discord chat server , wiki and mod database . Multiplayer anti-griefing mechanics out of the box. Open You can customize your game experience in infinite ways. Built from the ground up with modding in mind - we use our own mod api to add new game content. Half of the game is under a readable source license . We built our own mod database , modelling and animation tools and made them open source. Independent Vintage Story is powered by our own cross-platform game engine. This allows us to tailor the engine exactly to our needs while still keeping hardware requirements low. We have no shareholders to please and are self-published. Loaded with content Progress through multiple ages Start out empty-handed in the stone age and learn to survive by foraging, hunting, crafting, and fighting. Live through the four seasons and advance further by smelting copper for more powerful tools, creating bronze alloys, learning to work iron, mechanize common tasks and ultimately reach the steel age. A wicked universe backed by original story elements Take on the role of a lost being in the body of a tall blue creature and discover the remnants of civilization. It is up to you to piece together who you are and what has happened from the little evidence that remains. During your journey you will encounter wayward creatures, find old stories, battle temporal instability, and endure temporal storms. One million square kilometers of procedurally generated landscapes Enter a vast open world populated by a range of cute, strange, dangerous, and horrifying creatures. Vintage Story utilizes a great deal of procedural technology to create immensely diverse landscapes, climate conditions, and geological features to always keep exploration fresh and exciting. Not just hardcore! Vintage Story offers multiple playstyles and a huge amount of customization options when you create a new game world. You have the power to choose a creative experience, a peaceful world, balanced survival, hardcore wilderness survival or quite literally anything inbetween. Unreal world simulation Having undergone 10 years of continuous development the VS game engine fully and believably simulates seasons, soil fertility, rock strata, localized weather patterns, rain, snowfall & snow accumulation, hail, realistic climate distributions, food spoilage, body temperature, animal husbandry, farming, block physics, inspiring sunsets and nightskies, mineralogy, knapping, clayforming, metallurgy, smithing, microblock editing and more Inspired by Nature Vintage Story is heavily inspired by natural processes of the real world and brings them into the game in a fun and enjoyable way. Our aim is to capture the beauty of the natural world and amplify the experience within our game.

mediaEvidence.description: Hytale is finally here! Posted by Hytale Team January 13, 2026 Hytale is finally here! The moment has arrived, Hytale is releasing into Early Access today! When we reacquired Hytale last November and became an independent studio, we promised to launch without any delays, and we are keeping that promise. The game is currently in Early Access in its truest form: unpolished and incomplete, but within those rough edges lies the foundation for something extraordinary. For the first time, Hytale is in the hands of the community, to help us shape it into the forever game you all deserve. Before you dive in, please keep in mind: Early Access - many features are still missing, and bugs are expected It's only been two months since we reacquired Hytale - and that's how long we've had to prepare the game and rebuild the team from the ground up Demand has exceeded our expectations, which means launch week will be bumpy, but we'll get everyone in Don't have an edition of Hytale yet, but want to join us in Early Access? Get the Starter Edition right here for only $19.99 USD. If you're not comfortable with an unfinished Early Access experience, that's okay. We'll still be here whenever you're ready! How did we get here? In the last few months, Hytale went from being stuck in development, to cancelled, to revived, and now… an Early Access release! This happened because the community remained strong and worked together to create the #savehytale movement, which ultimately convinced the original founders to return and revive Hytale. Since announcing the Early Access , a fire was lit under the team to work harder than ever, and now, we can finally say the words that have been burning inside of us for years: Hytale is released! In just eight weeks , we worked on a 4+ year-old build of the game, merged hundreds of branches, fixed core systems such as camera, movement, combat, crafting, building, audio, and rendering, squashed thousands of bugs, and added numerous new features. Now, we are finally able to share with you a playable version of Hytale. It's a rough and unfinished Early Access build, but it clearly demonstrates the game's potential. We are having a great time working on the game, and we hope you share the same joy playing. What does the Early Access of Hytale contain today? build, explore, and do much more. Inspired by Minecraft, pushing beyond. Originally forked from MineClone (by davedevils) as MineClone 2, then renamed

Terasology Welcome to Terasology What is Terasology? An open source voxel world - imagine the possibilities! The Terasology project was born from a Minecraft-inspired tech demo in 2011. Over the years it has been a playground for different kinds of technical experiments and proof of concepts. The community strives to make Terasology a stable platform for various types of gameplay settings in a voxel world. Learn more Join our Discord Recent News Announcement Bifrost: First Contact Something is stirring. In a new age we try again, and bring something to inspire with. The Video That's Terasology inte… By: Cervator Posted on: April 01, 2026 Read More Announcement Exploring Revival Milestone 3 - Upgrades, Fixes and Improvements Left, Right and Center Exploring Terasology Revival Milestone 3: Our continued focus on performance and quality was supported by various fixes… By: Niruandaleth Posted on: June 26, 2024 Read More Announcement Revival Milestone 2 Complete - Elevating Quality, Boosting Performance, Advancing to Java 17! Completing Terasology Revival Milestone 2 - where quality meets performance, and Java 17 takes the spotlight.
We’re cel… By: Niruandaleth Posted on: January 14, 2024 Read More Find More Blogs About Us History The project was founded in 2011 by Benjamin "Begla" Glatzel while researching procedural terrain generation and effective rendering techniques. He succeeded in creating a minecraft-like demo engine, the foundation stone for what Terasology is today. We are always on the lookout for contributors with expertise in rendering, networking and concurrency, as well as in-game physics and AI technology. If you are interested in game engine development, come check out our Terasology Engine & Module Land . Modules & Gameplays From the ground up, Terasology was built to be very modular and support different kinds of gameplay ideas. We still host a large number of modules under the "Terasology" GitHub organization providing basic and advanced gameplay content as well as world generation options and technical libraries. Combining these modules allows to create very different kinds of gameplay in our voxel worlds. The possibilities are manifold and range from crafting- or trading-oriented survival over capture-the-flag to puzzle-style experiences and tower defenses. We especially appreciate expertise or interest in UI/UX, world generation or well-thought out gameplay mechanics, but also always have an open ear for crazy ideas for existing or new modules and gameplay content. If you are interested in gameplay development, come check out our Terasology Engine & Module Land . Community The Terasology community is a diverse mix of software developers, designers, game testers, graphic artists, musicians and other open source loving "Gooeys" . We value a positive, inclusive and respectful environment without harassment, attacks or inappropriate activities of any form. We encourage and appreciate contributions from everybody, and try to accept constructive criticism even by newcomers as gracefully and warmly as possible. and welcoming as possible to newcomers. If you want to talk to us or be the next in our group of Gooeys, come join us on our Terasology Discord .

Created by Markus "Notch" Persson in an incredible 48-hour burst of creativity, Minicraft is the essence of what makes games truly special. This top-down 2D crafting and survival game captures the pure joy of gaming, stripped of complexity but rich in depth. Whether you're a retro gaming enthusiast, a game developer looking for inspiration, or simply someone who appreciates gaming in its purest form, Minicraft offers an experience you won't want to miss. Choose Your Perfect Edition Minicraft The legendary original version that started it all. Perfect for purists and gaming historians: Experience the exact version that amazed the game development community Pure and unaltered gameplay mechanics that inspired countless games Historical significance as a milestone in game development Perfect example of elegant game design Incredibly lightweight and runs on any system The original Air Wizard challenge Download Original Edition Minicraft Plus The actively updated community edition that builds upon perfection with: All the charm of the original plus dozens of new features Regular updates and community-driven improvements Multiple challenging boss encounters Improved crafting system with new recipes Improved world generation for endless exploration Quality-of-life improvements while maintaining the original charm Active community and ongoing development Download Improved Edition Explore Minicraft Community Editions Core Features Top-Down Adventure Experience a unique 2D perspective of survival gaming with charming pixel graphics and intuitive controls Deep Crafting System Create tools, weapons, armor, and special items to advance your journey and face greater challenges Epic Boss Battles Challenge yourself against formidable foes including the legendary Air Wizard and other mysterious entities Multiple Worlds Explore diverse environments from the surface world to underground caves and floating sky islands Resource Management Gather resources, manage your inventory, and survive in a world full of dangers and opportunities Day/Night Cycle Experience dynamic gameplay as the world changes between day and night, bringing new challenges Farming System Plant and grow crops to sustain yourself, with various seed types and growth stages to master Character Progression Improve your character through better gear, unlocking new abilities and becoming more powerful Gameplay Elements Combat System Master strategic combat with various weapons and tools. The new update is already on Google Play, the version number looks like that “2.4.xx.8”. mediaEvidence.title: Unreal Software - game dev and stuff
mediaEvidence.description:
Stranded II Face the fight for survival again! However this time there is much more to discover and to explore compared to the prequel. The whole island world is now better designed and has more details. It's possible to tame or poison animals or to burn trees for example. Far more than 100 different items want to be found, used, combined, eaten or used in construction.
    Many new buildings allow you to build a powerful camp which offers protection and unexpected comfort. There is now a real adventure that spans several islands and is driven by tasks, diary entries and interaction with other islanders. Of course there are also additional individual missions. For example an island where you can play tower defense, a raptor hunting island or a mysterious color game. That's not enough for you? Take a look at the editor and create your own islands. A clever scripting system offers nearly unlimited options.
    Objects can be changed with definitions and scripts as well. It's even possible to add completely new objects and thus change the entire game.
